title: Gemini-3.1-pro CoT prompt shape controls whether it reasons at all
summary: Building probe/72_stratified_judge.py (stratified pip_collage/limb_geometry/other/none defect judge for the content-leakage hypothesis), an initial long CoT prompt (full failure-mode taxonomy before the reasoning instruction, 4-item checklist, 'reply with ONLY compact JSON no markdown fence') made gemini-3.1-pro-preview skip reasoning entirely and emit just the JSON verdict -- 0/6 live smoke calls had any reasoning text.
root_cause: Prompt structure/length before the CoT trigger apparently lets the model shortcut straight to the answer; confirmed by side-by-side test: probe/38_gemini_judge.py's shorter HOLDOUT_PROMPT (2-item CoT) reliably DID produce reasoning on the identical image pair.
solution: Kept the taxonomy compact, added explicit 'You MUST reason before answering ... Do not skip this reasoning paragraph', and required a literal 'JSON:' line marker as a concrete phase boundary (instead of vague 'on a new line'). Produced full CoT reasoning on every subsequent test call.
time_cost: ~20min (smoke test caught it before the real 120-image run)
prevention: For any new Gemini/VLM judge prompt requiring CoT, smoke-test on 2+ live calls and print full response text (not just parsed JSON) before trusting reasoning is present -- a schema-valid response can still silently skip reasoning.

title: Stratified defect judge (pip_collage vs limb_geometry vs other) on holdout30, original ref, old vs new arm
summary: Built probe/72_stratified_judge.py to test the content-leakage hypothesis (PiP/collage defect = ref background copied wholesale into gen; contrasted with limb_geometry which is unrelated anatomy error). Ran on holdout30 original-ref generations (30 uids x 2 seeds = 60 images/arm), reusing probe/38_gemini_judge.py's Kaon/Gemini-3.1-pro integration. 0 API errors, 0 missing images across both arms.

metrics.value: old: same_character yes/partial/no=16/27/17, visible_defect=yes 53/60, defect_type pip_collage=26 other=27 limb_geometry=0 none=7 | new: same_character yes/partial/no=26/24/10, visible_defect=yes 55/60, defect_type pip_collage=52 other=2 limb_geometry=0 none=5
metrics.baseline: n/a (first stratified pass; supersedes lumped visible_defect-only rate from probe/38)
metrics.delta: new arm has ~2x the pip_collage count of old (52 vs 26) despite similar overall visible_defect rate (55 vs 53) -- old's defects skew toward 'other' (27) instead, new's skew almost entirely to pip_collage; limb_geometry is ~0 in both arms, i.e. essentially none of the visible-defect rate in either arm is anatomy-driven

title: Spot-check caveat: 'other' bucket can also contain reference-driven leakage, and top-left concentration may be partly positional/generic
summary: 5-image visual spot-check (ref vs gen vs verdict) after the holdout_orig judge run: (1) u752 new-arm pip_collage is a textbook true positive (literal cropped ref panel pasted as a strip). (2) u6556 old-arm 'other' verdict is genuinely reference-driven -- that ref is itself heavily artist-watermarked, and the gen echoes garbled pseudo-text in a similar corner, but per the schema's own definition watermark/text bins to 'other' not pip_collage, so pip_collage alone can undercount reference-driven leakage. (3) defects concentrate almost universally in the top-left corner across both arms; some (u2542_s1) don't resemble that specific ref's actual content at all, suggesting a generic/positional artifact class independent of per-image leakage that won't necessarily disappear when refs are background-matted -- a residual pip_collage/other rate post-matting should not be read as automatically falsifying the hypothesis without per-image inspection.

title: Cross-model KV-injection determinant: why Z-Image transfers identity via strip but Lumina-2.0 does not
summary: Instrumented probe/30 (Z) and probe/80 (Lumina) InjectProcessors with default-off measure(per-layer target-query->ref-key softmax mass, +renormalized ref-column entropy/peak) and ref_bias(uniform pre-softmax logit on ref cols=causal routing knob). Measured on SAME u2 ref, matched deep bands. FALSIFIED prior sub-agent hypothesis 'Lumina softmax ignores no-phase strip keys': both attend 4-9% (Z 0.069, Lumina 0.038-0.094); key norms ref==ctx in both (no norm starvation); Lumina softmax scale is LARGER not smaller. Determinant = content-addressing SELECTIVITY of the position-free key: Z per-query ref-attention 2.4x more PEAKED (entropy 0.70 vs 0.81, peak 0.102 vs 0.043) -> structured id; Lumina diffuse -> color-bleed. Causal ref_bias sweep (CORRECTED at low w=1/0.5 deep band 16-23 after advisor caught a value-magnitude confound in the first w=2 band8-15 sweep that washed to blank): forcing mass up DOES monotonically transfer pink identity (dose-response, hair pinkness R-G 18->37 as mass 0.04->0.64) -> routing IS causal. BUT at matched mass 0.07 Lumina shows ~0 id (pinkness 21~=grey 18) while Z shows FULL id (pinkness 65); Lumina needs ~8-10x mass and coherence collapses en route -> no clean rescue.
root_cause: Position-free content-addressing efficiency is architecture-dependent (Z high, Lumina ~8x lower), candidate cause RoPE theta 256 vs 10000 (correlational, not swap-isolated). Lumina rope/pos-bound copy-pastes -> V carries identity; only the phase-free key routing is diffuse.
solution: Verdict: graded, causally-verified determinant EXISTS (comparative-mechanism/analysis paper defensible) but NO clean training-free rescue of Lumina (method/universal-recipe paper NOT supported). Figures: out/lumina/causal/{attn_quant_comparison,montage_decisive_ZvsLumina,selectivity_doseresponse,montage_D_deep_w1}.png; data FINDINGS.json + selectivity.json + partD_loww_summary.json.
prevention: Any forced-attention causal test on Lumina MUST use low injection weight (w<=1): w>=2 blows the cond_norm/noise_norm renorm and washes to blank = a value-magnitude artifact that masquerades as 'routing failed'. Match bands across models before comparing.

title: Correction: Lumina forced-attention = MEAN-COLOR bleed, not structured identity (advisor caught overclaim)
summary: Refining the prior exp entry: the ref_bias dose-response raising 'pinkness' is NOT identity transfer. Visual audit of D_deep16-23_w1_rb3/rb4 (pre-collapse) shows the MODEL'S OWN face, dark-grey eyes (NOT ref's PURPLE), NO red pendant -- only diffuse pink tint on hair-tips/collar. Pinkness plateaus at ~37 = ref MEAN hue (39.5), never Z's structured 65. This is exactly what mean-value injection predicts on a DIFFUSE attention (Lumina peak 0.043 vs Z 0.102). So: structured identity NEVER transfers in Lumina at any coherent operating point -> verdict (1) clean-rescue DEAD.
root_cause: Two honest caveats for the verdict: (a) rising color != identity (only structured features count); (b) the selectivity-gap CAUSE is unisolated at N=2 -- RoPE theta is confounded with GQA(30kv vs 8kv, untested)/depth/Gemma2-text-enc/data. Claim only the selectivity DISSOCIATION as discriminator, NOT theta as cause.
solution: Verdict = characterized (2): clean matched-mass dissociation (Z full structured id / Lumina none at 0.07) + failed rescue + unisolated cause. Comparative-mechanism paper defensible only if framed as selectivity discriminator; upgrade lever = isolate cause within one model (high-theta rotation on Z's injected key) or 3rd model on theta gradient.
prevention: In identity-transfer probes, never score color/hue as identity -- require structured features (eye color+shape, accessories, face geometry) before claiming transfer; a mean-hue proxy rises under pure color-bleed.

title: Z-only theta-causal isolation of phase geometry: INCONCLUSIVE (built-in null), NOT falsified -> stay descriptive
summary: Added refpos='thetasweep' to 30_kv_inject.py (default off; rotate injected ref key with actual RoPE at sweepable ref_theta, center-positioned). Swept theta 256->1000->4000->10000 on Z's identity band16-25 w4 u2. Selectivity moved in predicted direction (peak 0.151->0.109, entropy 0.618->0.680) but SATURATED by theta=1000 and ENDPOINT LANDED ON Z's OWN strip anchor (peak0.102/ent0.703), nowhere near Lumina's diffuse anchor (0.043/0.806). Structured identity (pink hair+purple eyes+red pendant) SURVIVED at every theta incl 10000.
root_cause: Advisor caught overclaim: RoPE freq_i=1/theta^(2i/d) means RAISING the KEY's theta REDUCES its rotation (frac frozen channels 0.21->0.54 over 256->10000) -> higher-theta key converges TOWARD the position-free STRIP key = Z's WORKING regime. So the sweep interpolates center@256 -> strip-like@10000, entirely within Z's working range; it CANNOT reach Lumina's failure by construction. Also it tests KEY-side theta while the hypothesis is QUERY-side (queries stay at 256). Query-side test infeasible: changing global theta breaks generation (confounds id-loss vs model-broke).
verdict: (2) DESCRIPTIVE. Within-Z theta isolation does NOT support a strong-causal 'phase geometry is THE cause' claim and cannot refute one -> cause UNRESOLVED. Do NOT upgrade to strong-causal AAAI; ship the characterized descriptive selectivity dissociation. 3rd-model-on-theta-gradient route reintroduces N-confounds.

criterion: pre-registered: off-curve win = identity>=taper AND collage gone, >=3/5
result: NEGATIVE 0/5 off-curve. late-gating REMOVES the pip/collage inset in all defective subjects (defect is temporally localized to the early high-noise composition pass) BUT identity collapses to generic every time (u2636 loses cat-ears+eye-color+hairstyle=different character; u2542/u4073 generic). w6/w8 add grain/frizz, not identity.
interpretation: identity co-forms with composition in the early denoising pass -> skipping early injection loses collage AND identity together. Reinforces distributed-identity/structural-tradeoff thesis: injection-side fixes fail across BOTH spatial (layer/head/token, 3 prior) AND temporal (schedule) axes.
decision: 4th failed defect-fix; fold into paper §4.6 as the temporal-axis negative (NOT re-pushed pending user OK). No further drill.

title: 时间门(late-injection)= 第4个失败的 defect 修法(时间轴)
summary: 1024px 生产配方(lowfreq/band10-25)下,taper 起 pip/collage 缺陷;把 KV 注入门到低噪晚期步(late50/late30,w4/6/8),缺陷被干净抹掉(缺陷在去噪时间上局部化于早期构图 pass),但身份每例都塌成泛化(u2636 丢猫耳+橙眼+发型=换了个角色)。预注册判据 off-curve 联合胜 0/5 → NEGATIVE。机制干净:身份与构图在早期 pass 同生,跳过早注入则二者同失。

title: 免训练目检必须在生产分辨率:512px 把 collage 缺陷整个压没
summary: 时间门第一版在 512px 目检,taper 锚看着'干净'→差点下'缺陷本就不存在'的错结论。核对被判过 pip_collage 的图发现缺陷只在 1024px 出现(左上角画中画插图/杂志文字水印)。重跑 1024px 才是有效检验。另:setsid 启动时 $PY 用外层双引号展开为空→直接跑 76_xxx.py 报 command not found、GPU 空转;须单引号让内层 source env.sh 后展开。
root_cause: collage 是分辨率依赖的 failure mode;低分辨率单主体不平铺。启动脚本变量展开层级错误。
solution: 训练-free 目检锚定生产分辨率(1024)与生产 recipe;setsid 内层 source 后用 "$PY" 单引号包裹。
time_cost: ~1 轮 512 sweep 作废 + 1 次空转 relaunch
prevention: eyeball-first 也要在会复现缺陷的配置上做,别图快降分辨率;后台启动先验证 real python proc 在跑(pgrep python.*script,别被 waiter 自匹配骗)。

title: n=60 训练目标复评:CCIP/perc 身份监督确认不是解药(证伪'目标是杠杆')
summary: advisor 建议的有界复评——把 step_1500 三臂(baseline=recon/ccip/perc)在完整 holdout30(n=60)重判(零新训练)。n=24 烟测的趋势在 n=60 坐实:baseline clean-yes 16.7%[9,28]/defect 13.3%;ccip 15.0%[8,26]/defect 26.7%;perc 10.2%[5,20]/defect 40.7%。两个监督臂 clean-yes 都≤recon 且缺陷率显著更高。→ 显式身份度量监督(最自然的训练侧修法)在足量样本上比朴素重建更差,不是缺陷解药。
interpretation: 证伪我早先'目标是杠杆'的推断(数据已两次打脸该推断)。训练侧修法(aux-loss)与注入侧四修法(层/头/token/时间)一致失败→加固'身份分布式且与构图纠缠、无局部/训练把手'的结构性论断。据 fable 裁决:只加固 null 表功效,不改结论方向,论文不等它、不再升级收敛训练。
decision: 关闭训练目标线;Path C 最顺路径(训练目标监督)判死;并入论文 §training-light 作训练侧确认性负面。

title: matplotlib PDF figures embedded rasters at 100 ppi (blurry submission)
summary: Paper figures looked compressed/broken in the compiled PDF while the source output PNGs were pristine 640^2/512x768.
root_cause: savefig loop passed dpi= only to .png/.tiff; .pdf/.svg fell back to matplotlib's default 100 ppi, resampling every imshow photo down to ~104px cells. The dpi=200 PNG I self-checked hid the defect.
solution: Pass dpi to the PDF/SVG savefig too: 400 for the 14.6in main/ablation figures (~450px, ~800 ppi after LaTeX shrink), 300 for the 48-cell supp gallery (~460px, ~half size). Verify with `pdfimages -list fig.pdf` (cell px, not just the compiled doc).
prevention: For any matplotlib figure with imshow saved to a vector format, always set savefig dpi>=300 on the .pdf/.svg call and confirm embedded px via pdfimages -list; never trust a high-dpi PNG as proxy for the PDF.

title: detect_heads 在动漫全身立绘上多框误检，n_heads==1 过滤会漏掉所有单人图
summary: 想从 datafactory 单图无字仓库挑单人动漫立绘做身份参考，用 imgutils detect_heads 后按『恰好1个头』过滤，250张里0张通过；子代理也因此误判『数据集没有单人帧』卡死。
root_cause: detect_heads 在1536x1024 高清全身立绘上会对同一角色/背景纹理误报2+个头框，几乎没有图恰好只返回1框。
solution: 照搬 probe/122 的做法：不按头数过滤，直接取面积最大的头框 max(dets,key=area) 做 0.35 padding 方形裁剪到768²；再用『最大头/次大头面积比 dom>=1.6』或角落亮度筛清晰单人立绘。refs/ 子目录里本来就有干净的角色设定图(bot_01/user)。
prevention: 任何用检测器挑单主体图的场景，别用『检测框==1』当单主体判据(误检普遍)，改用『最大框占比+主导度(最大/次大)』；参考实现见 probe/122 与 probe/133_df_showcase.py。

title: gpt-image-2 出图:Yata 异步 504 抽风,改用 Kaon 同步通道且 b64 在 url 字段
summary: 给论文 Fig1 用 GPT-Image-2 生框架图。Yata 异步 submit/status(openai-gpt-5.4-image-2)反复 504 超时(图片生成超时);换 Kaon 同步 /v1/images/generations(huskyi/gpt-image-2)一次成功,~60-80s。
root_cause: Yata GPT-Image-2 上游间歇性 504(kaon-api.md 已记录其不稳定)。另:Kaon 同步返回 schema 与文档不符——文档说只返回 data[0].b64_json、url 为空,实测相反:图片 base64 在 data[0].url 里以 data:image/png;base64,... 形式返回,b64_json 缺失,按文档只取 b64_json 会 KeyError。
solution: 框架/概念图优先走 Kaon 同步通道:POST https://kaon-router.kaonai.com/v1/images/generations, model=huskyi/gpt-image-2, size='1456x816'(会等比放大到~1675x939), 头带 User-Agent: OpenAI/Python 1.0.0 且先 pop 掉 http(s)_proxy。解析用 b64 = data[0].get('b64_json') or data[0]['url'].split(',',1)[1]。Kaon key=sk-kaon-5053…(在 ~/cluster/gen/outputs/ref_real_full_20260606/run_pipeline.sh)。
prevention: 调 gpt-image-2 出图:①Yata 异步抽风就切 Kaon 同步(更稳,无需轮询);②解析 b64 同时兼容 b64_json 与 url(data: 前缀);③关键:prompt 里标签保持≤4词、禁公式/真实缩略图,GPT-Image-2 才不糊——短标签概念图它画得很干净。

title: LaTeX overfull "at lines X-Y" 是当前 \input 分节文件的行号,不是主文件——追错 Fig1 caption 很久
summary: 合规检查发现 1 个 35.4475pt overfull hbox,报告 'in paragraph at lines 40-51'。主文件 40-51 行恰好是 Fig1 的 figure* caption,于是依次改图宽(0.995/0.98/0.90)、破折号(---→ ---)、行内公式(\frac→斜杠)、整段 caption 换成 'X'、甚至整块删掉 fig:method——overfull 值始终纹丝不动 35.4475pt。
root_cause: pdflatex 处理 \input 时行号会重置为被 input 文件的行号;'lines 40-51' 其实是 method_v3/30_tables.tex 的第 40-51 行(tab:controls 表),与主文件 Fig1 caption 的 40-51 纯属巧合。真凶=tab:controls 五列 lrrrr 塞在单栏 table(非 table*)里,行标签过长(Attribute-only generator/Same-class wrong teacher)导致 tabular 盒超单栏宽 35.4pt。
solution: 精简行标签(去 generator/reconstruction 等冗余词)+ tabcolsep 4.5→4pt → overfull 归零。定位法:看 log 里 overfull 紧邻的 (./file.tex) 上下文判断当前在哪个 input 文件;或用 rule/删块二分法确认与被疑内容无关。
prevention: overfull 'at lines X-Y' 先确认是哪个 \input 文件的行号(看 log 上下文的文件括号),别默认是主文件;展平版行号才对应真实位置。单栏放宽表用 table* 或先数列宽。

title: matplotlib 图 PDF 用 ghostscript 重压成 JPEG,过 AAAI 10MB 归档限
summary: Fig2(main_eval30)内嵌 14 张动漫 hero 栅格,matplotlib 以无损 Flate 编码→单图 PDF 5MB,主 PDF 5.3MB、归档 11MB 超 AAAI 10MB 上限。gs -sDEVICE=pdfwrite -dColorImageFilter=/DCTEncode -dColorImageResolution=300 -dJPEGQ=90 重压:5MB→487KB(10×),矢量文字/线不动、300dpi q90 印刷级目检无损。supp_gallery 2.9MB→316KB 同理。
why: matplotlib 不原生 JPEG 编码嵌入图;gs 后处理是标准做法(与 sec 项目 JPEG q88 一致)。300dpi 因图在全宽 figure* 里每格才~1.3寸、546px 源≈420dpi,降到 300 仍足印刷。
alternatives: 降 imshow 源分辨率(省得少);全 PDF gs(会改主 PDF 全部图);保持大文件(违规)。
impact: 归档 11MB→1.3MB。压缩已内嵌 probe/127、132 的 jpeg_compress_pdf(graceful skip,gs 缺失不报错),重渲染自动保持小体积;顺带删 191MB 冗余 dpi=600 .tiff,figures/ 245MB→39MB。
